words.defn_en: denoting or characteristic of countries of Europe and the western hemisphere:

sentences.zh: 他在大學期間同時研習西方與亞洲哲學。

words.defn_en: a rhetorical device in which the speaker brings up a subject by claiming to pass over it:

sentences.zh: 這位辯論者運用了假隱實顯的修辭手法,說道:「我甚至不會提到他過去的醜聞。」

sentences.zh: 透過假隱實顯的手法,這位律師巧妙地提醒陪審團被告的脾氣。

words.defn_en: person in his or her eighties:

sentences.zh: 這位八十多歲的老人每天早餐前仍然堅持散步。

sentences.zh: 她那身體硬朗、已經八十多歲的祖母,每天仍然在花園裡忙碌。

words.defn_en: a marine mollusk with eight arms:

sentences.en: The ______ changed color instantly to blend with the coral reef.
sentences.zh: 這隻章魚瞬間變換顏色以融入這片珊瑚礁。

sentences.en: Marine biologists study the ______ for its remarkable intelligence.
sentences.zh: 海洋生物學家研究章魚驚人的智力。

words.defn_en: something unusual or strange:

sentences.zh: 這座博物館展出了一件有趣的奇特物品。

sentences.en: His refusal to use a smartphone is seen as quite an ______ these days.
sentences.zh: 如今他拒絕使用智慧型手機的行為,被視為一件相當奇特的事。

words.defn_en: loathsome; evil; revolting in a disgusting way

sentences.zh: 這位參議員對移民所發表的可惡言論引發了眾怒。

sentences.en: Cleaning the sewer was an ______ task nobody wanted.
sentences.zh: 清理下水道是一項沒人願意做的令人厭惡的工作。

words.defn_en: the quality of being extremely unpleasant or repulsive:

sentences.zh: 這本小說生動細膩地捕捉了這個政權殘暴行徑令人厭惡的一面。

sentences.zh: 辦公室裡的每個人都認清了他不斷散播閒言閒語令人生厭的一面。

sentences.zh: 這位獨裁者因其殘暴的政策而遭到國際間普遍的憎惡。

sentences.en: Public ______ forced the corrupt official to resign.
sentences.zh: 公眾的憎惡迫使這位貪腐的官員辭職。

words.defn_en: having a distinctive, often unpleasant smell:

sentences.zh: 這塊氣味濃烈的起司被禁止放入共用的冰箱裡。

sentences.en: An ______ mixture of chemicals filled the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 一股氣味刺鼻的化學混合物瀰漫了整間實驗室。

sentences.en: The retrospective exhibit spanned the artist's entire ______ .
sentences.zh: 這場回顧展涵蓋了這位藝術家的全部作品。

words.defn_en: the internal organs of a butchered animal, used as food; waste material:

sentences.zh: 這位主廚將簡單的內臟料理轉化成一道優雅的美味佳餚。

sentences.en: The factory disposed of ______ in a designated area.
sentences.zh: 這家工廠將廢棄物棄置在指定的區域。

words.defn_en: to cause someone to feel upset or angry; to violate:
words.root_note: offendere (to strike against), from Latin ob- + fendere (to strike)

sentences.en: He didn't mean to ______ anyone with his blunt comment.
sentences.zh: 他直率的評論並非有意冒犯任何人。

sentences.en: The company's ad campaign managed to ______ several cultural groups.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的廣告活動不慎冒犯了好幾個文化群體。

words.defn_en: done or said without preparation or thought; casual:

sentences.en: His ______ remark upset many of the employees, even though he didn't mean harm.
sentences.zh: 他隨口說出的一句話讓許多員工感到不悅,儘管他並無惡意。

sentences.en: His ______ remark surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 他隨口的一句話讓所有人都感到驚訝。

words.defn_en: offering one's services when they are neither wanted nor needed:
words.defn_zh: 多管閒事的/自以為是的

sentences.en: The ______ new employee kept giving unsolicited advice to everyone.
sentences.zh: 這位多管閒事的新員工不斷對每個人提出不請自來的建議。

sentences.en: Her ______ attempts to help only made the situation more awkward.
sentences.zh: 她自作主張想幫忙的舉動,只是讓情況變得更加尷尬。

words.defn_en: a side branch or derivative of something larger:
words.root_note: off + shoot, from Old English sceotan

sentences.en: The new department began as a small ______ of the research division.
sentences.zh: 這個新部門最初只是研究部門的一個小分支。

sentences.en: Jazz gave rise to numerous musical ______ s throughout the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 爵士樂在整個二十世紀衍生出眾多的音樂分支。

words.defn_en: oily or greasy; excessively flattering:
words.root_note: oleaginus (of the olive tree), from Latin oleum (oil)

sentences.en: The ______ salesman praised every feature of the outdated car.
sentences.zh: 這位諂媚的推銷員極力誇讚這輛過時汽車的每一項特色。

sentences.en: The dish had an unpleasantly ______ texture.
sentences.zh: 這道菜有著令人不悅的油膩口感。

words.defn_en: a miscellaneous mixture of things:

sentences.en: The variety show offered an entertaining ______ of music and comedy.
sentences.zh: 這場綜藝節目提供了音樂與喜劇交織的娛樂大雜燴。

sentences.en: Her closet was an ______ of vintage and modern styles.
sentences.zh: 她的衣櫃是復古與現代風格交融的大雜燴。

sentences.zh: 這道家常燉菜在一個陶罐裡慢燉了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Archaeologists uncovered an ancient ______ buried beneath the ruins.
sentences.zh: 考古學家在這片遺跡下方發現了一個古老的陶罐。

words.defn_en: an event regarded as a sign of future good or bad fortune:

sentences.zh: 村民們將這場日蝕視為一個不祥的徵兆。

sentences.en: A rainbow after the storm felt like a hopeful ______ .
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後出現的彩虹感覺像是一個充滿希望的預兆。

words.defn_en: threatening:

sentences.en: Dark, ______ clouds gathered in the sky before the storm hit.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來襲前,天空聚集了不祥的烏雲。

sentences.zh: 宣布消息之後,房間裡瀰漫著一股不祥的寂靜。

sentences.zh: 乘客們擠上這輛駛往市區的馬拉公共汽車。

sentences.en: The publisher released an ______ edition containing all three novels in one volume.
sentences.zh: 出版社發行了一本合集版,將這三部小說收錄在同一冊之中。

words.defn_en: operating or sensitive in all directions:

sentences.zh: 這支麥克風的全方向設計捕捉了來自各個角度的聲音。

sentences.en: Engineers installed an ______ antenna to improve signal reception.
sentences.zh: 工程師安裝了一支全方向天線,以改善訊號接收。

words.defn_en: of all varieties, forms, or kinds:

sentences.zh: 這場慶典展現了世界各地文化各式各樣的表演。

sentences.en: Her interests were ______ , ranging from astronomy to ancient poetry.
sentences.zh: 她的興趣種類繁多,從天文學到古代詩歌無所不包。

words.defn_en: almighty, unlimited in power or authority:

sentences.zh: 在這則神話中,這位神被描繪成全能且無所不見的。

sentences.zh: 這名獨裁者希望人民相信他幾乎是全能的。

words.defn_en: existing everywhere at once:

sentences.zh: 智慧型手機在現代社會中幾乎已經無所不在。

sentences.zh: 在許多宗教傳統中,神被描述為無所不在的存在。

words.defn_en: eating foods from both plants and animals:

sentences.zh: 熊是雜食性動物,從漿果到魚類什麼都吃。

sentences.zh: 人類天生就是雜食性的,既能消化肉類也能消化蔬菜。

words.defn_en: the interpretation of dreams to predict the future:

sentences.zh: 古埃及祭司運用解夢占卜術來指引法老的決策。

sentences.en: Her grandmother still believed in the old traditions of ______ .
sentences.zh: 她的祖母至今仍然相信古老的解夢占卜傳統。

sentences.zh: 同時照顧孩子和年邁的父母證明是件相當繁重的事。

words.defn_en: the formation of a word that imitates the sound it describes:

words.defn_en: relating to words that imitate the sounds they describe:

sentences.en: Children's books frequently use ______ language to engage young readers.
sentences.zh: 童書經常運用擬聲語言來吸引年幼的讀者。

words.defn_en: the beginning or early stages:

sentences.zh: 醫生表示及早治療可以延緩這種疾病的發作。

sentences.zh: 在刑事審判中,舉證責任落在檢方身上。

sentences.zh: 他感受到領導的責任沉重地壓在他的肩上。

sentences.zh: 他終於在二十多歲時戒掉了童年時期咬指甲的習慣。

words.defn_en: not able to be seen through; not transparent; hard to understand:

sentences.zh: 這扇霧面玻璃門完全不透明。

words.defn_en: generous in giving:

sentences.zh: 她慷慨大方的天性讓她深受整個社區的愛戴。

sentences.zh: 這位專欄作家會針對時事自由發表意見。

sentences.zh: 在這場激烈的辯論中,她把自己的看法保留在心裡。

sentences.zh: 這項調查蒐集了大眾對這項擬議政策的意見。

words.defn_en: having strong views and expressing them forcefully:

sentences.zh: 這位主觀武斷的評論家很少承認其他觀點。

sentences.zh: 他在這項判決後對裁判大聲辱罵。

sentences.zh: 她在這場典禮上可恥的行為讓賓客們感到震驚。

sentences.zh: 這位學者寫了一篇文章來質疑這個廣為接受的理論。

sentences.zh: 很少有人敢在公開場合質疑這位將軍的權威。

sentences.zh: 她今天早上到眼鏡行取回了她的新眼鏡。

sentences.zh: 他因難以看清路標而預約了一位驗光師。

sentences.zh: 這座宮殿展現出令人驚嘆的皇室富裕氣派。

sentences.zh: 訪客們對舞廳裝飾所展現的極致奢華感到驚嘆。

words.defn_en: wealthy, luxurious, or lavish:

sentences.zh: 這座奢華的宮殿裡擺滿了精緻的藝術品與金色的裝飾。
